examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{自伝|じでん}を{書|か}いた。
その{政治家|せいじか}の{自伝|じでん}がベストセラーになった。
examples.english: That politician's autobiography became a bestseller.

examples.japanese: {引退後|いんたいご}に{自伝|じでん}を{出版|しゅっぱん}する{有名人|ゆうめいじん}は{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many celebrities publish autobiographies after retiring.

notes:
A written account of one's own life. Composed of {自|じ} (self) and {伝|でん} (biography). Unlike a memoir, which may focus on select episodes, a {自伝|じでん} typically covers the author's entire life chronologically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自伝|じでん}を{書|か}く: write an autobiography
- {自伝|じでん}を{出版|しゅっぱん}する: publish an autobiography
- {自伝|じでん}{的|てき}{小説|しょうせつ}: autobiographical novel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {伝記|でんき}: biography — written by someone else about the subject
- {回顧録|かいころく}: memoir — may cover only part of one's life
- {評伝|ひょうでん}: critical biography — includes evaluation and analysis
